title_sq: Ish fusha e aviacionit, pedonalja shitet super apartament 2+1 , me HIPOTEKË.
description_sq:
Tiranë
Ish fusha e aviacionit, pedonalja shitet super apartament 2+1 , me HIPOTEKË.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 3 banimi te një pallati të ri me 2 ashensor.
Sipërfaqja bruto 86 m2 .
Eshte i përberë nga salloni dhe guzhinë e gatimit, depo, tualet me dritare, 2 dhoma gjumi, si dhe ballkoni me pamje nga pedonalja .
 Shitet edhe me kredi .
Cmime 155.000 euro i diskutueshëm.
title_en: The former aviation field, pedestrian area, super apartment 2+1 for sale, with MORTGAGE.
description_en: Tirana The former aviation field, the pedestrian area, super apartment 2+1 for sale, with MORTGAGE. The apartment is located on the 3rd floor of a new building with 2 elevators. Gross area 86 m2. It consists of living room and kitchen, storage room, bathroom with window, 2 bedrooms, as well as a balcony overlooking the pedestrian area. It is also sold on credit. Price 155,000 euros debatable.
